# Dream Quest Media Books — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> An author-focused website aimed at showcasing and selling books directly to readers. The site needs to serve both as a promotional platform to highlight the author's work and as a sales channel for purchasing books.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Dream Quest Media Books
An author-focused website aimed at showcasing and selling books directly to readers. The site needs to serve both as a promotional platform to highlight the author's work and as a sales channel for purchasing books.

## Services/Products
- book promotion
- book sales

## Target Audience
- Fiction Fantasy Enthusiasts
- Online Book Club Members
- Young Adult Literature Fans
